newsitem.title: UK: Guinness off after Seagram's flat spirits.
newsitem.headline: Guinness off after Seagram's flat spirits.

text.p: Shares in Guinness Plc were trading lower on Thursday after Seagram Co Ltd's spirits division turned in flat third quarter sales, dealers said.
Guinness shares were down seven pence, or 1.37 percent, to 503p by 1400 GMT in volume of 3.25 million while the FTSE-100 index was 3.4 points, or 0.08 percent, higher at 4,439.4.
"The Seagram figure has knocked Guinness back a bit," said a marketmaker at a British bank.
Seagram said on Wednesday revenues for its spirits and wines group were flat at about $1.1 billion in its third quarter, but its pre-tax profits rose nine percent to $143 million.
Guinness recorded an 18-month intra-day high at 527p on April 23. It had rallied from a 410p intra-day low on January 17.
